title: allowed-tools includes write-capable git patterns
description: `Bash(git branch:*)` permits `git branch -D/-f` and `Bash(git symbolic-ref:*)` permits the 2-arg write form and `--delete`, contradicting the adjacent prose claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only and specs/review-command/spec.md's rule that allowed-tools MUST NOT include Bash patterns permitting writes. Fix: drop both; `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD` and `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` cover the read uses.

title: "Report-only enforced structurally" overstated for three agents
description: reviso-finder-history, reviso-finder-prior-reviews, and reviso-verifier grant bare `Bash` in frontmatter, so 'read-only git commands only' is prompt-level convention, not structural (agent `tools:` lists can't pattern-scope Bash). D3's claim that a write attempt is a tool-permission failure is really prompt obedience plus user permission config. candidate.sh's dirty-tree check is a good backstop; add an honest caveat in D3 or a PreToolUse hook later.

title: Stale command spelling `/reviso review`
description: docs/evals.md still uses the space form `/reviso review` two lines below the stub edited in this PR, while README/CONTRIBUTING moved to `/reviso:review`.

title: Prompt-injection surface not documented in SECURITY.md
description: finder-prior-reviews ingests PR comments, and match.sh/extract.sh embed reviewed text into prompts. Bounded by read-only tooling, but worth a SECURITY.md sentence eventually.

title: PR bundles ~6 concerns, violating one-concern-per-PR
description: The PR ships the OpenSpec change, the plugin, Stage-1 detectors, the parity eval harness, a vendored recipe snapshot, and doc TODO resolution in one PR despite the repo's 'one concern per PR' rule; the commit stack was clearly built for stacked PRs and landed as one.

title: No committed test for `detect.awk`
description: DISCOVERY.md describes synthetic-fixture validation but neither fixture nor runner is in-repo, so the only executable non-prose code ships regression-unguarded. Cheap fix: commit the fixture diff, expected TSV, and a 3-line sh test.

title: "Matches at most once" is prompt-enforced only
description: Nothing mechanically prevents duplicate pairs from the model; a duplicate double-counts in baseline majority and judge buckets. A jq dedup on `a_idx`/`b_idx` would harden it.

title: Loud-failure cross-check only greps one phrasing
description: The cross-check greps only the `found N issue` phrasing, so other wordings slip through silently.
